description: oh-my-pi (omp) via its native stdio ACP subcommand, a runtime separate from pi (pi-acp). Provider access stays in your omp login; Garuda never reads it.
warnings: Vendor capability mediation is negotiated at handshake; strict garuda-only policies may be refused — review before mutating runs.

No-prompt conformance only (omp 18.16.0): initialize, session/new, idle cancel and process cleanup were exercised; prompted turns, permission requests, mode and option selection, session/load, usage and error normalization were not. See docs/development/omp-acp-conformance.md.
setup: 1. Install the omp (oh-my-pi) CLI and log in with `omp login`. 2. Verify: omp --version (conformance was checked on omp/18.16.0; other versions are unverified). Garuda never reads ~/.omp or omp's credential vault, and never calls `omp token` or `omp auth`.

login.instructions: Run `omp login` for your model provider, then select this runtime.
